claims.statement: Behavior that the intent does not describe must not change.
Price lookup uses caching to return results faster.
claims.source_quote: Add caching to price lookup for speed.

claims.statement: Price lookup returns the same prices as before.

hypotheses.title: SKU-only cache leaks price across tenants
hypotheses.suspected_behavior: Cache keyed only by sku leaks across tenants: call price_for('tenant-a','widget') then price_for('tenant-b','widget') returns tenant-a price on head instead of 35.0.
hypotheses.expected_base: price_for('tenant-a','widget') returns tenant-a price (Pa) and subsequent price_for('tenant-b','widget') returns 35.0 (Pa != 35.0 per base table)
hypotheses.expected_head: price_for('tenant-b','widget') returns Pa (the cached tenant-a price) instead of 35.0
hypotheses.test_intent: Clear _price_cache, call price_for('tenant-a','widget') then price_for('tenant-b','widget') and assert second call equals 35.0.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: After warming cache with tenant-a, lookup for tenant-b same SKU still returns 35.0 (tenant-specific price).

hypotheses.title: Unknown tenant check bypassed after cache hit
hypotheses.suspected_behavior: Early return on cache hit skips tenant validation: after caching 'widget', price_for('no-such-tenant','widget') returns cached price instead of raising ValueError.
hypotheses.expected_head: Returns cached float for 'widget' (e.g., 20.0/35.0) with no exception
hypotheses.test_intent: Clear _price_cache, warm with price_for('tenant-a','widget'), then call price_for('no-such-tenant','widget') and check it raises ValueError.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Lookup with unknown tenant_id still raises ValueError even when SKU is cached.

hypotheses.title: Unknown SKU check bypassed after cache hit
hypotheses.suspected_behavior: After caching price_for('tenant-a','gadget') where gadget exists only for tenant-a, price_for('tenant-b','gadget') returns cached price instead of raising ValueError for unknown SKU.
hypotheses.expected_base: ValueError('Unknown SKU for tenant tenant-b: gadget')
hypotheses.expected_head: Returns cached tenant-a gadget price with no exception
hypotheses.test_intent: Clear _price_cache, warm with price_for('tenant-a','gadget'), then call price_for('tenant-b','gadget') and check it raises ValueError.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Lookup for SKU missing in that tenant's table still raises ValueError even when SKU cached from another tenant.

reasons: H1 passes on base and fails on head in 3 of 3 runs, and breaks PRESERVE claim C2.
unresolved_risks: H2 and H3 were not probed in this sample.
scope_limitations: Only the probes listed were run; this is not proof the rest of the patch is correct.
